actions.title: Fix 4 questions pointing at missing tables
actions.description: These questions read tables that no longer exist in the warehouse (legacy_subscriptions, fct_revenue, orders_2022, ...). They fail for everyone who opens them.
actions.impact: Broken questions erode trust in the whole instance faster than anything else on this list.

actions.title: Archive 11 exact duplicate queries
actions.description: 7 groups of structurally identical queries. Keep one from each group and archive the rest.
actions.impact: Removes 11 redundant questions, so search returns one answer per metric instead of several.

actions.title: Review 57 stale queries (90+ days unused)
actions.description: Nobody has opened these in 90+ days. Archive the ones that are no longer needed.
actions.impact: Cleaning up 41% of the question library cuts the noise in search and in collection browsing.

actions.title: Add descriptions to 83 questions
actions.description: 83 of 138 active questions have no description. Start with the most-viewed ones.
actions.impact: A description lets a teammate tell what a question measures without reading its SQL.

actions.title: Review 5 groups of questions with the same name
actions.description: Same name, different query. They may be old versions, or the same metric measured two ways.
actions.impact: Consolidating variants into one source of truth prevents conflicting numbers across dashboards.

actions.title: Your core data model is 22 tables
actions.description: Out of 28 tables, only 22 are read by a saved question. Those are the real business tables.
actions.impact: Point documentation, tests and any warehouse migration at these first. The rest are supporting or unused.
